caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame with four tall, turned posts at each corner, each capped with a rounded finial. The wood is illustrated in shades of brown with visible wood grain patterns. The headboard and footboard both have horizontal planks with decorative cutouts at their upper ends, and a row of vertical spindles between horizontal rails just below the top boards. The side rails are fastened to the headboard and footboard and show a series of consistent brass-colored bolt heads. The bed frame stands on a flat, neutral-colored background, and there are faint shadows cast on the surface underneath the frame. The text "SCALE 1/8 TO THE INCH" is centered below the bed.
title: Bishop Hill: Bed
